"image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 18,
        "source_block_index": 23,
        "text": "这道题我的做法是："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 19,
        "source_block_index": 24,
        "text": "1. 设两个链表，并写一个求绝对值的函数。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 20,
        "source_block_index": 25,
        "text": "2. 遍历题目给的单链表（只能从头到尾遍历）。同时开一个布尔数组，用来记录绝对值是否出现过。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 21,
        "source_block_index": 26,
        "text": "3. 如果单链表当前元素的绝对值在布尔数组里是第一次出现，就把它接在新链表的后面，并将布尔数组中该绝对值对应的值置为 true。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "p

aragraph",
        "ordinal": 22,
        "source_block_index": 27,
        "text": "4. 如果该绝对值曾经出现过，就直接跳过这个数，继续遍历下一个数。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 23,
        "source_block_index": 28,
        "text": "以此类推，最后形成的新链表就是题目所需要的单链表。第二张图片是我的答案，第三张图片是题目的解析。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 24,
        "source_block_index": 29,
        "text": "如果我的答案不是最优解，不用考虑最优解的问题，只用看我的算法对不对就行，然后简单提一下最优解即可。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 25,
        "source_block_index": 30,
        "text": "另外，关于这道题的复杂度：如果题目给的链表长度是 m，那这道题的时间复杂度是

O(m)，空间复杂度是 O(n)（题目给的这个 n）。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 26,
        "source_block_index": 31,
        "text": "助手（第 1 轮）"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 27,
        "source_block_index": 32,
        "text": "本题资料依据：2026 年 408 大纲中的线性表、链式存储与算法复杂度要求，项目知识点标签表中的 DS02-06 单链表、DS02-09 单链表删除、DS02-15 线性表算法设计、DS01-11/12 复杂度分析，以及《数据结构习题解析与实验指导》第 2 章对应的 2015 年真题解析。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 28,
        "source_block_index": 33,
        "text": "当前判断"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 29,
        "source_block_index": 34,
        "text": "你的文字

算法思想是正确的，而且时间效率已经达到这道题要求的最优数量级。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 30,
        "source_block_index": 35,
        "text": "但是："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 31,
        "source_block_index": 36,
        "text": "第二张图中的代码实现目前不正确，不能真正生成或修改出目标链表。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 32,
        "source_block_index": 37,
        "text": "复杂度方面，按 408 参考答案的作答口径："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 33,
        "source_block_index": 38,
        "text": "时间复杂度 O(m)，空间复杂度 O(n)。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 34,
        "source_block_index": 39,

"text": "你的判断是对的。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 35,
        "source_block_index": 40,
        "text": "已确认正确"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 36,
        "source_block_index": 41,
        "text": "你已经抓住了本题最核心的三点："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 37,
        "source_block_index": 42,
        "text": "1. 利用题目给出的 |data|≤n，开辅助数组记录某个绝对值是否出现过。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 38,
        "source_block_index": 43,
        "text": "2. 从前到后只扫描链表一遍，因此可以保留第一次出现的结点。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 39,
        "source_block_index": 44,
        "text": "3. 后续

绝对值相同的结点不再保留。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 40,
        "source_block_index": 45,
        "text": "这正是参考解析采用的“空间换时间”思路：申请大小为 n+1 的标记数组，检查 t[abs(data)]，首次出现就标记，重复出现就删除。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 41,
        "source_block_index": 46,
        "text": "第一断点：辅助数组的下标写错了"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 42,
        "source_block_index": 47,
        "text": "你代码里写的是："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 43,
        "source_block_index": 48,
        "text": "bool number[n] = {false};\n\nif (number[a->data] == false)"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 44,

"source_block_index": 49,
        "text": "这里有两个边界问题。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 45,
        "source_block_index": 50,
        "text": "1. 必须取绝对值"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 46,
        "source_block_index": 51,
        "text": "题目判断的是 |data|，所以应该使用："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 47,
        "source_block_index": 52,
        "text": "int k = abs_n(a->data);"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 48,
        "source_block_index": 53,
        "text": "再访问："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 49,
        "source_block_index": 54,
        "text": "number[k]"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal

": 50,
        "source_block_index": 55,
        "text": "否则当 data=-15 时，会访问 number[-15]，这是非法下标。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 51,
        "source_block_index": 56,
        "text": "你虽然写了 abs_n()，但后面并没有调用它。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 52,
        "source_block_index": 57,
        "text": "2. 数组大小必须是 n+1"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 53,
        "source_block_index": 58,
        "text": "因为 0≤|data|≤n，可能访问的下标是 0,1,2,...,n，一共有 n+1 个位置。因此 bool number[n] 只能访问 0～n-1，当 |data|=n 时会越界。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 54,
        "source_block_index": 59,
        "text": "应当是："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],

"kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 55,
        "source_block_index": 60,
        "text": "number[n + 1]"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 56,
        "source_block_index": 61,
        "text": "在标准 C++ 中，n 是运行时参数，不能直接定义这种变长普通数组，更规范的写法是 vector<char> number(n + 1, false)。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 57,
        "source_block_index": 62,
        "text": "代码中更关键的链表问题"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 58,
        "source_block_index": 63,
        "text": "即使把绝对值和数组大小修正，你当前代码仍然没有真正完成链表操作。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 59,
        "source_block_index": 64,
        "text": "你写的是："
      },
      {

"image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 60,
        "source_block_index": 65,
        "text": "b = a;"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 61,
        "source_block_index": 66,
        "text": "这只是让局部指针 b 改为指向 a，并没有执行："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 62,
        "source_block_index": 67,
        "text": "b->link = a;"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 63,
        "source_block_index": 68,
        "text": "因此它没有把结点接到结果链表后面，res 所指链表也不会发生变化。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 64,
        "source_block_index": 69,
        "text": "而重复元素的分支中，你只是继续执行 a = a->link，这只是跳过了当前结点，但原链表中的该结点仍然存在

"image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 75,
        "source_block_index": 80,
        "text": "资料冲突说明"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 76,
        "source_block_index": 81,
        "text": "用户提供的解析图明确写的是空间复杂度 O(n)，这是正确的。项目中的《数据结构习题解析与实验指导》文字版在同一处出现了“空间复杂度为 O(1)”的表述，但其前文又明确申请了大小为 n+1 的辅助数组，前后矛盾，应属于文字或排版错误；按算法本身必须判定为 O(n)。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 77,
        "source_block_index": 82,
        "text": "最优解简单说明"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 78,
        "source_block_index": 83,
        "text": "标准解法就是：一个标记数组 + 两个链表指

针，直接在原链表中删除重复结点。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 79,
        "source_block_index": 84,
        "text": "时间上不可能优于 O(m)，因为至少要检查全部 m 个结点一次。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 80,
        "source_block_index": 85,
        "text": "因此，你的核心思路已经是最优时间思路；真正的问题不在算法方向，而在于代码没有正确处理绝对值下标、数组边界、前驱指针和删除链域。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 81,
        "source_block_index": 86,
        "text": "下次遇到“删除单链表结点”，第一动作先写出："
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 82,
        "source_block_index": 87,
        "text": "LNode* pre = head;\nLNode* p = head->link;"

},
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 83,
        "source_block_index": 88,
        "text": "因为删除当前结点时，真正需要修改的是它的前驱结点 pre 的指针域。"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],
        "kind": "paragraph",
        "ordinal": 84,
        "source_block_index": 89,
        "text": "用户（第 2 轮）"
      },
      {
        "image_refs": [],

应当是：
